annotations.title: Convert a document to Markdown with Docling

description:
Convert a document up to 25 MB and 200 pages to Markdown with Docling:
OCR, tables, headings and reading order.

Pass the file as base64 in `content_base64`, or as a download link in
`file`, and its name in `filename`. Returns `task_id` and `task_status`.
Call `get_conversion` with the `task_id` until `task_status` is `success`
or `failure`; a long PDF can take several minutes.

Costs 1 credit per PDF page converted (2 with `force_ocr`) and 10 credits
per other file, refunded if the conversion fails. Requires an API key.
The file is deleted when the conversion ends; the result is kept for
7 days.

content_base64.description: The file content, base64-encoded. Up to 25 MB before encoding.

file.description: The file as a download link, instead of `content_base64`. In ChatGPT, pass the user's uploaded file here. Other clients can set `download_url` to a public https URL.

download_url.description: A public https URL of the file.

file_id.description: An identifier for the file. ChatGPT sets it; other clients may pass any label, such as the file name.

filename.description: The file name with its extension, such as report.pdf. Docling reads PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, Markdown, CSV and images.

force_ocr.description: Replace a PDF's text layer with OCR text. Doubles the price of a PDF.
